_source.note: Skill advancement only. Role Ability Ranks and STAT increases are out of scope for this file and must not be inferred from it.

_rules.skill: Raising a Skill to a new Level costs the new Level multiplied by the per-level cost. A Skill flagged doubleCost in skills.json costs twice that, the same x2 flag the printed sheet marks.
_rules.levelling: One Level at a time. Raising a Skill several Levels costs the sum of each step, so the price climbs as the Skill does.
_rules.maximum: maxLevelInPlay in skills.json (10) is the ceiling; a Skill already there cannot be raised.
